clone_rule: Reuse the frozen source model, feature order, score cutoff, horizon, cost and capacity. Change only the point-in-time candidate universe.
universe_membership_source: Alpha Vantage LISTING_STATUS active U.S. listings

universe_screen.exchanges: all active U.S. exchanges in the preserved listing snapshot
universe_screen.relative_volume_definition: completed decision-session volume divided by the mean volume of the prior 20 completed sessions
universe_screen.uptrend_definition: EMA bullish alignment is true and the completed close is above EMA(9), EMA(21), and EMA(50)
universe_screen.range_definition: ATR(14) divided by completed close is at least 3 percent
universe_screen.screen_availability: Every price, volume, technical and market-cap value must be source-pure Schwab data available no later than the frozen decision cutoff

label: completed decision close to fifth subsequent regular-session close
